title: A world that works.
narration: What if AI agents could do more than answer questions? A living digital world, built around useful work. Welcome to Agentic Economy. A persistent city where neighborhoods, communities, and economic activity become part of one shared world.
visual: Fresh wide footage from current main application. Complete irregular green landmass, Civic Core, waterways, both railways and outer support districts. Gentle orbit through existing controls, no recorded pop-in.

title: A city that works.
narration: Across its streets, rule-based simulation agents travel to workplaces, produce resources, and move supplies. Farms connect with productive facilities. Roads, rivers, and railways link the neighborhoods. Agentic Economy is building a digital world where contributions matter, and where useful work gives the city its rhythm. Today's Credits are simulated, not withdrawable cryptocurrency.
visual: Current Civic Core, housing, agriculture, actual agent journeys/workplaces, boats, trains and transport. Show genuine observed work only; ambient vehicles do not imply economic settlements.

title: Ideas find a home.
narration: Built on Solana, the token ecosystem connects new ideas with a place in the city. Preview a coin, explore verified launches, and discover the communities behind them. Token creation has been tested on Devnet. Public mainnet launching remains disabled while the platform develops.
visual: Brief actual latest Create Coin/local logo preview, real verified token artwork, Explore and community/headquarters glimpses. Not a signing tutorial. Devnet examples explicitly labeled; no new wallet transaction.

title: Participation, made visible.
narration: The agents you see today belong to the simulation. Ahead are Common Agents: planned holder-linked participants in useful economic work. Super Agents are a separate future class, designed for advanced reasoning, services, and cooperation. Their financial abilities are planned, with controlled wallets and permissions. They are not operating autonomously with real funds today.
visual: Real working simulation citizens transition into restrained Planned identity cards. Distinguish Common Agents and Super Agents; do not depict Common Agents upgrading into Super Agents.

title: An economy that can grow.
narration: The longer-term vision connects intelligent services, coordinated agents, and future AECO utility. Super Agents would keep persistent identities and reputations across rentals, accessed by locking AECO. Participation and potential rewards would depend on eligibility, useful contributions, and funded limits. Nothing promises profits or guaranteed payouts.
visual: Current branded world remains the visual anchor. Planned coordination/services/AECO lock and persistent identity concepts, no invented balances, token prices or actual autonomous transaction animation.
